properties.name: vanillabp.cockpit.process-engine-api.remembered-user-tasks
properties.description: How many delivered user tasks one node keeps in memory. The Process-Engine-API cannot be asked about a task a second time, so the node keeps what arrived with the delivery until the task is gone. The key is read here only. A workflow module which writes it at 'vanillabp.workflow-modules.<module>.cockpit.process-engine-api.remembered-user-tasks' ends the start, because the memory is one per node and shared by every workflow module.
